title: Nis2RiskManagementMeasure
description: NIS2-sourced archetype — cybersecurity risk-management measure under Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Article 21(2) defines 10 mandatory measure categories that essential and important entities must implement. Each measure is independently assessable. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: NIS2 Article 21(2)(a)-(j).

measureCategory.description: One of the 10 mandatory cybersecurity risk-management measure categories. RISK_ANALYSIS_AND_IS_SECURITY_POLICY: Art 21(2)(a). INCIDENT_HANDLING: Art 21(2)(b). BUSINESS_CONTINUITY_AND_CRISIS_MANAGEMENT: Art 21(2)(c). SUPPLY_CHAIN_SECURITY: Art 21(2)(d). NETWORK_AND_IS_ACQUISITION_SECURITY: Art 21(2)(e) (includes vulnerability handling and disclosure). EFFECTIVENESS_ASSESSMENT: Art 21(2)(f). CYBER_HYGIENE_AND_TRAINING: Art 21(2)(g). CRYPTOGRAPHY_AND_ENCRYPTION: Art 21(2)(h). HR_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL: Art 21(2)(i). MULTI_FACTOR_AUTHENTICATION: Art 21(2)(j).

implementationLevel.description: Implementation maturity of this measure. NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no measure in place. PARTIAL: measure exists but does not fully cover the requirements. IMPLEMENTED: measure fully covers the requirements. VERIFIED: measure implemented and independently assessed per Art 21(2)(g).

proportionalityJustification.description: Justification for the proportionality of the implemented measure relative to entity size, exposure, severity of potential incidents, and cost of implementation. Source: NIS2 Art 21(1) (proportionality principle).

lastAssessmentDate.description: Date of last effectiveness assessment of this measure. Source: NIS2 Art 21(2)(g).
